bibl.title: Hermopolis Magna at the Crossroads of Cultures.
bibl.seg: Marek Barański, Hermopolis Magna at the Crossroads of Cultures.

Grażyna Bąkowska-Czerner & Rafał Czerner (edd.), Greco-Roman Cities at the Crossroads of Cultures. The 20th Anniversary of Polish-Egyptian Conservation Mission Marina el-Alamein (Oxford, 2019) pp. 7-18, figg.
bibl.note: In the Greco-Roman period Hermopolis Magna became an important place of cultural exchange. Chosen examples - the Hellenistic Corinthian capital, the Gymnasium, the Agora with its Great Tetrastylon, and the Great Basilica are situated at the town's main crossroad or next to it. They are the result of an intercultural exchange and new ideas brought to Khmun thereby created the Greco-Roman Hermopolis and then next Coptic Shmun. Discusses these monuments and researches their importance in various contexts and aspects.
